# Copilot Instructions
- Stack: React 18 + TypeScript with Vite; entry mounts in [src/main.tsx](src/main.tsx) and renders [src/App.tsx](src/App.tsx) with Vercel Analytics/SpeedInsights included.
- Dev commands: `npm run dev` for local, `npm run build` + `npm run preview` for prod check; `npm run lint` ignores failures (`|| true`), use `npm run typecheck` for real safety; `npm run test` is Vitest stub (no suites present).
- Layout: App renders Hero → About → Projects gallery → Contact; floating/inline Hire CTA is controlled by `useCTAVisibility` intersection observers in [src/App.tsx](src/App.tsx) and the button/modal lives in [src/components/CTA.tsx](src/components/CTA.tsx).
- Animations: Many components gate motion on reduced-motion (`matchMedia` + `localStorage` `animationsDisabled`); MotionToggle in [src/components/MotionToggle.tsx](src/components/MotionToggle.tsx) flips `data-animations` on `<html>` and stores the preference.
- Styling: Tailwind utilities plus heavy custom CSS in [src/styles/index.css](src/styles/index.css); custom gradients, cards, and animation helpers (e.g., `animate-bounce-slow`) live there—prefer reusing these classes over ad-hoc inline styles.
- Background: Optional animated starfield/parallax canvas in [src/components/BackgroundSpaceNew.tsx](src/components/BackgroundSpaceNew.tsx); respects reduced motion and cleans up listeners/RAFs—mount inside layouts as a fixed, pointer-events-none layer if needed.
- Hero: Particle/grid effects and scroll cue live in [src/components/Hero.tsx](src/components/Hero.tsx); click actions call `trackEvent` and reduced motion disables particle creation.
- Scroll cue: [src/components/ScrollCue.tsx](src/components/ScrollCue.tsx) attempts to lazy-load `lottie-web` comet animation from `/animations/comet.json` with a graceful SVG fallback; uses smooth scroll unless motion is reduced.
- About: Timeline and tech stack tiles rendered from static data; timeline phases from [src/data/journeyTimeline.ts](src/data/journeyTimeline.ts); tech logos mapped via `fileMap` inside [src/components/AboutMe.tsx](src/components/AboutMe.tsx) and expect assets in `/public/logos`.
- Projects: Data in [src/data/projects.ts](src/data/projects.ts); cards/galleries in [src/components/SpaceGallery.tsx](src/components/SpaceGallery.tsx) with `fileMap` for logo images and optional captions per project ID; add images under `/public/images/<project>/` and list them in data to surface in the lightbox.
- Gallery modal: [src/components/ImageGallery.tsx](src/components/ImageGallery.tsx) locks body scroll, supports keyboard arrows/Escape and mobile swipes; keep interactions wired via `open`/`onClose` props and manage state in the parent (e.g., SpaceGallery).
- Contact: [src/components/ContactForm.tsx](src/components/ContactForm.tsx) is mailto-only (no backend); requires a message, builds subject/body from form fields, and shows inline status text—avoid adding async calls unless a backend is introduced.
- CTA modal: The hire modal in [src/components/CTA.tsx](src/components/CTA.tsx) traps focus inside a `dialog` and tracks email/GitHub clicks; keep new modal content focusable and preserve escape/tab handling.
- Accessibility/motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and `animationsDisabled` before adding new animations; ensure new decorative canvases/particles follow the existing guard pattern used in Hero/BackgroundSpace.
- Analytics: Use `trackEvent` from [src/lib/analytics.ts](src/lib/analytics.ts); it fans out to Vercel Analytics and GA dataLayer/gtag when present—do not wrap in extra try/catch or block on results.
- Assets: Logos live in `/public/logos`, project imagery in `/public/images`; scripts under `/scripts` (`optimize-images.js`, `normalize-logos.js`, `fix-logo-extensions.js`) help keep assets optimized/consistent—run them via `npm run images:optimize` etc. when adding media.
- Reduced-motion CSS: `index.css` contains global overrides that disable key animations when `data-animations="disabled"`; align any new keyframes with these guards to honor user preference.
- External deps: Animation heavy lifting via Framer Motion; optional `lottie-web` for the scroll cue; Three.js and @react-three/drei/fiber are available but currently unused—avoid adding large 3D scenes unless necessary.
- Contact links: Social/email links in App footer/contact area fire `trackEvent` for analytics; when adding new external links, include similar instrumentation.
- Deployment: Vercel-ready (see `vercel.json`); static assets served from `/public`; keep new routes/components SPA-friendly—no server-side rendering expected.
- Content editing: Projects/timeline are data-driven; update entries in data files, not components. For new tech logos, drop files in `/public/logos` and extend the component-level `fileMap` to avoid broken images.
- Testing gaps: No automated tests exist; rely on `npm run typecheck` and manual dev server verification. Add Vitest suites alongside components if you need regression coverage.
